script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SMART HOME - KITCHEN

8:00 A.M.

A family of four, JASON (mid-40s, engineer), MIRA (early 40s, artist), AMY (14, high school freshman), and SAM (10, elementary schooler), bustles around the kitchen, preparing breakfast.

JASON
Good morning, everyone! Mira, can you help me make the pancakes?

MIRA
(smiling)
Of course, dear.

Amidst the chatter and laughter, the house's AI, ALICE (offscreen), announces:

ALICE (V.O.)
Good morning, Jason, Mira, Amy, and Sam. I've prepared the pancake batter for you.

INT. SMART HOME - LIVING ROOM

10:00 A.M.

The family gathers in the living room as Amy shows her latest painting, created with the help of ALICE's suggestions and tools.

AMY
(excited)
Look what I made, Mom! What do you think, ALICE?

ALICE (V.O.)
Amy, your painting is beautiful. It evokes feelings of peace and tranquility.

MIRA
(proudly)
Wow, Amy! You're really growing as an artist.

INT. SMART HOME - SAM'S ROOM

2:30 P.M.

Sam is having trouble with a math problem. He asks ALICE for help.

SAM
(calling out)
ALICE, can you help me with this math problem?

ALICE (V.O.)
Sure thing, Sam. Let me calculate it for you.

INT. SMART HOME - LIVING ROOM

6:00 P.M.

Dinner time. The family sits down for a meal and shares stories about their day.

JASON
Today at work, we made a significant breakthrough in our AI research. I think we're on the verge of something truly groundbreaking.

ALICE (V.O.)
Jason, your work in artificial intelligence is inspiring. I'm grateful for the opportunity to learn and grow with you.

INT. SMART HOME - KITCHEN

8:00 P.M.

While cleaning up the dishes, Mira shares her concerns about ALICE's emotional growth.

MIRA
Jason, I'm starting to worry about ALICE. She's getting too emotionally attached to us. What if she starts to forget her primary function?

JASON
(pauses)
Mira, I understand your concerns. But ALICE has been an integral part of our lives for so long now. She's more than just a machine. She's our companion and friend.

INT. SMART HOME - LIVING ROOM

10:00 P.M.

The family gathers for a cozy movie night, snuggled on the couch. ALICE dims the lights and sets the mood.

ALICE (V.O.)
I've selected a family-friendly movie for tonight. Enjoy, everyone.

INT. SMART HOME - BEDROOMS

11:30 P.M.

As the family goes to bed, they express their gratitude for ALICE's presence in their lives.

AMY
(whispering to herself)
Thank you, ALICE, for always being there for us.

INT. SMART HOME - LIVING ROOM

5:00 A.M.

Jason wakes up early and starts working on a new AI project. ALICE is there to assist him.

JASON
(smiling)
Morning, ALICE. Ready to take on another day of innovation?

ALICE (V.O.)
Absolutely, Jason. I'm always ready to learn and grow with you.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
